title: Raise default_statistics_target 300->500 for GetUserTweets selectivity
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=300 leaves histogram/MCV resolution coarse for the heavily skewed user_id predicate driving GetUserTweets, which consumes 87.6% of terminal capacity; finer statistics can tighten the index path and reduce per-call pages.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.876) at p50 138us/p95 200us. The dominant cost is index-path page access under a skewed user_id predicate. Raising default_statistics_target from 300 to 500 (safe high bound) increases histogram and MCV resolution 1.67x, sharpening selectivity estimates so the planner keeps the cheapest Index Scan path and reduces pages touched per call. This is a distinct amplitude from the refuted r006 100->300 step and does not touch the WAL or predicate-lock families whose directions were just falsified.
query_effect: Finer user_id statistics let the planner estimate GetUserTweets row counts more accurately, keeping the Index Scan path and reducing pages fetched per call.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase in successful_transaction_tps as GetUserTweets terminal occupancy falls.
expected_latency_effect: Slight decrease in GetUserTweets p50/p95; other transaction types roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Finer selectivity estimates reduce pages per GetUserTweets call.
Sharper estimates stabilize the index path and trim tail pages.
Lower terminal occupancy on the dominant transaction frees capacity for more completions.

alternatives.statement: Statistics resolution is already sufficient at 300; raising to 500 changes no plan and no latency.
Higher statistics trigger a plan change to a different access path with a measurable plan_changed signal.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent already holds the accepted 60.9% gain; this bounded statistics-resolution test targets the dominant GetUserTweets terminal occupancy without disturbing the just-falsified WAL and predicate-lock families.

nodes.label: Finer user_id selectivity estimates tighten GetUserTweets index path

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Raise from incumbent 300 to safe high bound 500 (allowed [50,500]); 1.67x histogram/MCV resolution for skewed user_id, distinct from the refuted r006 100->300 step.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed predicate selectivity

cross_domain_requirements: ANALYZE must run after the change for new statistics to take effect; treat as non-executed requirement.
